Now I have a complete picture of all 4 files. Let me compile the full structured audit.

---

## FILE: access.ts (mounted at `/api`)

**CF-already-covered routes (from cf-extra-routes.ts):**
- GET /companies/:companyId/join-requests — ALREADY IN CF
- GET /companies/:companyId/user-directory — ALREADY IN CF

**Skills routes (all use `readSkillMarkdown` / `fs.readFileSync` / `fs.statSync` / `fs.readdirSync` — Node-only FS):**
- GET /skills/available — uses `listAvailableSkills()` → `fs.readdirSync` + `fs.readFileSync` — SKIP (Node-only fs)
- GET /skills/index — returns static JSON list (no FS read in body), but the function it's co-located with uses FS — actually this handler itself does NOT call FS — pure static JSON response — ADD TO CF (pure static, no DB or FS)
- GET /skills/:skillName — calls `readSkillMarkdown()` → `fs.readFileSync` — SKIP (Node-only fs)

**CLI auth routes (all pure DB via `boardAuth.*` service which wraps DB):**
- POST /cli-auth/challenges — pure DB (creates CLI auth challenge) — MISSING from CF
- GET /cli-auth/challenges/:id — pure DB (reads challenge + actor check) — MISSING from CF
- POST /cli-auth/challenges/:id/approve — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- POST /cli-auth/challenges/:id/cancel — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- GET /cli-auth/me — pure DB (resolves board access) — MISSING from CF
- POST /cli-auth/revoke-current — pure DB (revokes board API key) — MISSING from CF

**Board claim routes (in-memory registry `inspectBoardClaimChallenge` / `claimBoardOwnership` which uses an in-process claim store):**
- GET /board-claim/:token — uses in-process `inspectBoardClaimChallenge` (memory state, not DB) — SKIP (Node-only in-memory registry)
- POST /board-claim/:token/claim — uses `claimBoardOwnership` (in-process memory + DB) — SKIP (in-process state dependency)

**Invite routes (pure DB):**
- GET /invites/:token — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- GET /invites/:token/logo — DB + `storage.getObject()` (streams binary from storage service) — SKIP or deferred (requires storage/R2 wiring)
- GET /invites/:token/onboarding — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- GET /invites/:token/onboarding.txt — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- GET /invites/:token/skills/index — pure DB (validates token, returns static list) — MISSING from CF
- GET /invites/:token/skills/:skillName — pure DB (validates token) + `readSkillMarkdown()` → `fs.readFileSync` — SKIP (Node-only fs)
- GET /invites/:token/test-resolution — pure DB (validates token) + `resolveInviteResolutionTarget` / `probeInviteResolutionTarget` which use `node:dns/promises`, `node:http`, `node:net`, `collectReachableInterfaceHosts` — SKIP (Node-only network probing)
- POST /invites/:token/accept — pure DB (complex invite acceptance/join request creation logic) — MISSING from CF
- POST /invites/:inviteId/revoke — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- GET /companies/:companyId/invites — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- POST /companies/:companyId/invites — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- POST /companies/:companyId/openclaw/invite-prompt — pure DB — MISSING from CF

**Join request approval routes (pure DB):**
- POST /companies/:companyId/join-requests/:requestId/approve — pure DB (creates agent/membership) — MISSING from CF
- POST /companies/:companyId/join-requests/:requestId/reject — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- POST /join-requests/:requestId/claim-api-key — pure DB (claims agent API key post-join) — MISSING from CF

**Members routes (pure DB):**
- GET /companies/:companyId/members — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- PATCH /companies/:companyId/members/:memberId — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- PATCH /companies/:companyId/members/:memberId/role-and-grants — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- POST /companies/:companyId/members/:memberId/archive — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- PATCH /companies/:companyId/members/:memberId/permissions — pure DB — MISSING from CF

**Admin routes (pure DB):**
- GET /admin/users — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- POST /admin/users/:userId/promote-instance-admin — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- POST /admin/users/:userId/demote-instance-admin — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- GET /admin/users/:userId/company-access — pure DB — MISSING from CF
- PUT /admin/users/:userId/company-access — pure DB — MISSING from CF

---

## FILE: company-skills.ts (mounted at `/api`)

**CF-already-covered:**
- GET /companies/:companyId/skills — ALREADY IN CF

**Pure DB routes:**
- GET /companies/:companyId/skills/:skillId — pure DB (`svc.detail`) — MISSING from CF
- GET /companies/:companyId/skills/:skillId/update-status — pure DB (`svc.updateStatus` — checks remote source metadata from DB) — MISSING from CF
- GET /companies/:companyId/skills/:skillId/files — pure DB (`svc.readFile` — reads skill file content stored in DB) — MISSING from CF
- POST /companies/:companyId/skills — pure DB (`svc.createLocalSkill`) — MISSING from CF
- PATCH /companies/:companyId/skills/:skillId/files — pure DB (`svc.updateFile`) — MISSING from CF
- DELETE /companies/:companyId/skills/:skillId — pure DB (`svc.deleteSkill`) — MISSING from CF

**Node-only routes:**
- POST /companies/:companyId/skills/import — calls `svc.importFromSource` which fetches from GitHub/skills.sh/URLs using Node fetch + potentially writes to filesystem — SKIP (Node-only: network fetch + possible fs writes for local skills)
- POST /companies/:companyId/skills/scan-projects — calls `svc.scanProjectWorkspaces` which scans local filesystem project directories — SKIP (Node-only fs scan)
- POST /companies/:companyId/skills/:skillId/install-update — calls `svc.installUpdate` which pulls remote source and writes to disk — SKIP (Node-only: network + fs writes)

---

## FILE: adapters.ts (mounted at `/api`)

**CF-already-covered:**
- GET /adapters — ALREADY IN CF (returns `[]`)

**Node-only routes (all involve adapter registry, npm install, fs reads, or child_process):**
- POST /adapters/install — uses `execFileAsync("npm", ["install", ...])` + `node:fs/promises` + `loadExternalAdapterPackage` — SKIP (Node-only: npm exec + fs)
- PATCH /adapters/:type — uses `setAdapterDisabled` (in-process adapter registry) — SKIP (Node-only: in-memory registry)
- PATCH /adapters/:type/override — uses `setOverridePaused` (in-process adapter registry) — SKIP (Node-only: in-memory registry)
- DELETE /adapters/:type — uses `execFileAsync("npm", ["uninstall", ...])` + in-process registry — SKIP (Node-only: npm exec + in-memory registry)
- POST /adapters/:type/reload — uses `reloadExternalAdapter` (dynamic module loading) + `readAdapterPackageVersionFromDisk` (fs) — SKIP (Node-only: dynamic require + fs)
- POST /adapters/:type/reinstall — uses `execFileAsync("npm", ...)` + dynamic module loading — SKIP (Node-only: npm exec + dynamic require)
- GET /adapters/:type/config-schema — uses `findActiveServerAdapter` (in-process registry) + `adapter.getConfigSchema()` — SKIP (Node-only: in-memory registry)
- GET /adapters/:type/ui-parser.js — uses `getOrExtractUiParserSource` (reads from installed adapter package on disk) — SKIP (Node-only: fs read from installed npm package)

---

## FILE: plugins.ts (mounted at `/api`)

**CF-already-covered:**
- GET /plugins — ALREADY IN CF (returns `[]`)
- GET /plugins/ui-contributions — ALREADY IN CF (returns `[]`)

**Node-only routes (all involve plugin worker processes, npm install, existsSync, or PluginWorkerManager):**
- GET /plugins/examples — uses `listBundledPluginExamples()` → `existsSync` on local monorepo paths — SKIP (Node-only: fs)
- GET /plugins/tools — requires `toolDeps.toolDispatcher` (plugin worker process) — SKIP (Node-only: plugin workers)
- POST /plugins/tools/execute — requires `toolDeps.toolDispatcher` (plugin worker process) — SKIP (Node-only: plugin workers)
- POST /plugins/install — calls `loader.installPlugin` which runs npm install + writes to disk — SKIP (Node-only: npm + fs)
- GET /plugins/:pluginId — pure DB (`registry.getById/getByKey`) + optional `bridgeDeps.workerManager.getWorker` check — PARTIALLY pure DB; the `supportsConfigTest` field requires the worker manager. Could be added with `supportsConfigTest: false` fallback — MISSING from CF (DB part is portable)
- DELETE /plugins/:pluginId — calls `lifecycle.unload` (stops plugin worker process) — SKIP (Node-only: plugin workers)
- POST /plugins/:pluginId/enable — calls `lifecycle.enable` (starts plugin worker process) — SKIP (Node-only: plugin workers)
- POST /plugins/:pluginId/disable — calls `lifecycle.disable` (stops plugin worker process) — SKIP (Node-only: plugin workers)
- GET /plugins/:pluginId/health — pure DB (`registry.getById/getByKey`) — MISSING from CF (pure DB, no worker needed)
- GET /plugins/:pluginId/logs — pure DB (`db.select().from(pluginLogs)`) — MISSING from CF
- POST /plugins/:pluginId/upgrade — calls `lifecycle.upgrade` (npm upgrade + worker restart) — SKIP (Node-only: npm + plugin workers)
- GET /plugins/:pluginId/config — pure DB (`registry.getConfig`) — MISSING from CF
- POST /plugins/:pluginId/config — pure DB (`registry.upsertConfig`) + optional worker RPC `configChanged` — MISSING from CF (DB part is portable; skip the worker `configChanged` call in CF)
- POST /plugins/:pluginId/config/test — requires `bridgeDeps.workerManager.call(..., "validateConfig")` — SKIP (Node-only: plugin workers)
- GET /plugins/:pluginId/jobs — pure DB (`jobDeps.jobStore.listJobs`) — MISSING from CF (with `jobDeps` absent → returns 501, acceptable)
- GET /plugins/:pluginId/jobs/:jobId/runs — pure DB (`jobDeps.jobStore.listRunsByJob`) — MISSING from CF (same 501 path)
- POST /plugins/:pluginId/jobs/:jobId/trigger — requires `jobDeps.scheduler.triggerJob` — SKIP (Node-only: job scheduler)
- POST /plugins/:pluginId/webhooks/:endpointKey — pure DB (delivery tracking) + `webhookDeps.workerManager.call` (plugin worker) — SKIP (Node-only: plugin workers)
- POST /plugins/:pluginId/bridge/data — requires `bridgeDeps.workerManager.call` (plugin worker) — SKIP (Node-only: plugin workers)
- POST /plugins/:pluginId/bridge/action — requires `bridgeDeps.workerManager.call` (plugin worker) — SKIP (Node-only: plugin workers)
- POST /plugins/:pluginId/data/:key — requires `bridgeDeps.workerManager.call` (plugin worker) — SKIP (Node-only: plugin workers)
- POST /plugins/:pluginId/actions/:key — requires `bridgeDeps.workerManager.call` (plugin worker) — SKIP (Node-only: plugin workers)
- GET /plugins/:pluginId/bridge/stream/:channel — uses `res.write()` SSE + `bridgeDeps.streamBus` (in-process event bus) — SKIP (Node-only: SSE + plugin stream bus)
- router.use /plugins/:pluginId/api — uses `bridgeDeps.workerManager.call(..., "handleApiRequest")` — SKIP (Node-only: plugin workers)
- GET /plugins/:pluginId/dashboard — pure DB (`pluginWebhookDeliveries` + `jobDeps` optional) + optional worker diagnostics via `wm.getWorker()` — MISSING from CF (DB part is portable; skip `worker` diagnostics field in CF, return null)
